# puerile

> of or characteristic of a child; displaying or suggesting a lack of maturity.

> Juvenile, immature


## Example

- *Helen enjoyed blowing soap bubbles, but Jim regarded this as puerile, totally unworthy of a woman with a Ph.D.*
